newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka hotel stocks rise on tourism revival.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka hotel stocks rise on tourism revival.

text.p: Shares of Sri Lanka hotels rose on retail buying in early trade on Wednesday, brokers said.
Galadari Hotels rose 7.69 percent, or 25 cents, to 3.50, while Ahungalla Hotels traded 1.85 percent or one rupee higher at 55.
"Retailers are buying the shares because they expect tourism to revive in 1997," said a broker who declined to be identified.
The state Ceylon Tourist Board said arrivals rose by 17 percent in the first quarter of 1997, compared with a 25 percent decline last year.
Tourism was affected in 1996 by a Tamil separatist bomb attack on the Central Bank and a crowded commuter train.
